TYPE ST_Pump :
STRUCT
    priority : INT;
    selection : BOOL;
    RunComd : BOOL;
END_STRUCT

FUNCTION_BLOCK MultiPumpSwitchingControl
VAR_INPUT
    mode : BOOL;
    start : BOOL;
    stop : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_IN_OUT
    pumpGroup : ARRAY[1..5] OF ST_Pump;
END_VAR
VAR
    tmp_runEnable : BOOL;
    tmp_i : INT;
    tmp_j : INT;
    tmp_higher : INT;
    tmp_equal_before : INT;
    tmp_selected : ARRAY[1..5] OF BOOL;
END_VAR
BEGIN
(* ENGINEERING_CONTRACT ... *)
(* CONTRACT_RULES [] *)

IF stop THEN
    tmp_runEnable := FALSE;
    FOR tmp_i := 1 TO 5 DO
        pumpGroup[tmp_i].RunComd := FALSE;
    END_FOR;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF start THEN
    tmp_runEnable := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF mode THEN
    FOR tmp_i := 1 TO 5 DO
        tmp_higher := 0;
        tmp_equal_before := 0;
        FOR tmp_j := 1 TO 5 DO
